description: Get short-lived download URLs for the accepted photos in one submission. Links are valid for 15 minutes and need no authorization headers; fetch each with a plain HTTP GET. The response has one URL per zip part of up to 100 accepted photos. Every zip contains manifest.csv with filename, photoId, capturedAt, source, lat, lng, accuracyM, locationSource, verdict, and distanceMeters, plus files named photo-0001.jpg and onward. Call again for fresh links. Owner only.

bountyId.description: The unique ID of the bounty the submission belongs to

submissionId.description: The unique ID of the photo-capture submission

name: get_accepted_photos_archive
title: Get accepted photos archive
